text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the days of training with Nice 
Nature—who had a habit of being a bit 
cynical—began.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she lacked extraordinary innate 
talent, she ran well enough to rival 
powerhouses like Mayano Top Gun and Tokai 
Teio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the fact remained that she 
couldn't quite seize first place. And that 
weighed heavily on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she continued to work hard toward 
her dream of "shining bright."
